character: Mel: everyday Kiwi woman, late 30s, been to a lot of open homes; dry and amused, giving a mate a tip before Saturday. Second-person advice only, never 'I' (no testimonial). General NZ accent, never a caricature; no announcer lift.

lines.on_screen: Real amber chip 'Overland flow path · Present — check', red-marker circle; caption 'Before any Auckland open home, / check the bit / nobody walks to.' (held to 3.0)
lines.text_v2: Before any Auckland open home… check this.
lines.text_v3: Before any Auckland open home… check this.
lines.delivery: A tip over the fence, not a warning. Small lean on 'Auckland', a real beat at the ellipsis, 'check this' low and dry, falling. Unhurried: there's room. Out by 2.85 (rewind whoosh at 3.0).

lines.on_screen: Flyer drops in after the 3.45 flash (paper slap 3.5): OPEN HOME · SAT 10:00–10:30 / 'Sunny. Flat. Easy-care.' over a finished home with a front lawn (Illustrative · not a real listing)
lines.delivery: Reading the flyer back with a tiny audible smile, no sarcasm; slightly listy, 'easy-care' a touch drier. Starts just after the paper slap. Out by 5.55.

lines.on_screen: Notes: Sunny / Dry / Easy-care ticked (5.60 / 5.80 / 6.00), 'Back corner' row (6.22), red '?' (6.46); caption 'Nobody walks out / past the shed.' (5.80–8.18)
lines.text_v2: Nobody walks out past the shed.
lines.text_v3: Nobody walks out past the shed.
lines.delivery: Deadpan observation a beat after the last tick; light weight on 'nobody', 'past the shed' falling away. Out by 8.15, before the caption leaves (8.18) and the swipe to the live screen (8.3).

lines.on_screen: Live qsme.co.nz screencast: tap on the search box (8.57), address types in (8.6–10.3), tap (10.97); caption 'On qsme.co.nz: / Sign up. / “Search your address.”' (8.55–11.68)
lines.text_v2: Q-S-me. Sign up. Type the address.
lines.text_v3: Q-S-me. Sign up. Type the address.
lines.delivery: Three practical beats like directions, starting with the tap; 'Q-S-me' clear (kyoo-ess-mee); 'Sign up' plain and matter-of-fact, like the obvious next step, never salesy. Out by 11.15, so the real 'Looking up the property…' line (11.15) plays in quiet.

lines.on_screen: Boundary trace 12.60–13.25; pills Boundary 12.75 / Land area 13.05 / Council 13.35 / Zone 13.65; outlines land on the real values
lines.delivery: Calm but brisk roll call landing each word near its pill: 'Boundary' with the trace, a short breath, then the other three, natural downstep. Out by 14.5 (scroll to Services starts 14.45).

lines.on_screen: Camera to Services; white outline hops chip to chip (15.00–16.09), amber thunk 16.22
lines.delivery: Two words almost under the breath, as if reading along, with a real gap between. Out by 15.75 (the scan ticks and the 16.22 thunk play in silence).

lines.on_screen: Punch-in on the amber chip, red circle redraws (16.72–17.1); caption 'Checked against / the whole section,' (16.75) + 'not just the front lawn.' (17.25), held to 20.6
lines.text_v2: Checked against the whole section, not just the front lawn.
lines.text_v3: Checked against the whole section, not just the front lawn.
lines.delivery: Unhurried, starts with the caption; light lean on 'whole'; hint of a smile on 'front lawn'. No pause before 'not'. Out by 20.35, while the caption is still up.

lines.on_screen: Spotlit amber chip 'Present — check' + the page's own footer; caption '“Check” means check.' slams in (21.3); red underline under 'Not a substitute for a LIM, PIM or engineering advice.' (21.45–22.1)
lines.delivery: Plain, honest, almost a shrug, on the caption slam; 'lim' lands as the underline runs under 'a LIM'. Said as one word (lim, rhymes with him), spelt lowercase so the voice never spells it out. Full stop, then breathe. Out by 22.6.

lines.on_screen: Notes card up (21.8–22.25); '?' scribbled out (22.35–22.75); 'Back corner: ask the agent.' types 22.75–23.25, 'Order the LIM.' 23.35–23.7; both held to 25.5 (end-card swipe 25.5)
lines.text_v2: It's what you ask at the open home.
lines.text_v3: It's what you ask at the open home.
lines.delivery: The warm turn, like good advice from a mate; 'ask' lands as 'ask the agent' types in; small lean on 'open home', falling end. Out by 25.45, before the end-card swipe (25.5).

lines.on_screen: End card (swipe 25.5–25.88): QSME / 'Check the back corner before you bid.' (25.98, red ring 26.55–27.0) / 'Search your address.' (26.75) / [Sign up at qsme.co.nz] (27.0) / 'Services & hazards: Auckland first' (27.2); holds to 29.9
lines.text_v2: Sign up at Q-S-me dot co dot en zed.
lines.text_v3: Sign up at Q-S-me dot co dot en zed.
lines.delivery: One easy line, reading the button back to a mate: 'Sign up at' as the card settles, a tiny beat, then 'Q-S-me dot co dot en zed' the Kiwi way, landing with the button (27.0). Friendly, low-key, no rise, no announcer lift. Out by 29.4 so the held chord resolves.

continuous_read_v2:
Before any Auckland open home… check this.

Flyer says sunny, flat, easy-care.
Nobody walks out past the shed.

Q-S-me. Sign up. Type the address.

Boundary… land area, council, zone.

Services… hazards.

Checked against the whole section, not just the front lawn.

It's not a lim.
It's what you ask at the open home.

Sign up at Q-S-me dot co dot en zed.
post_processing: Time base: seconds on outputs/back-corner-9x16.mp4 (the only cut: full 29.9 s 9:16 master, no offset). Times checked against frames of the master and the T table in motion/back-corner.html.

v2 per line with previous_text/next_text stitching; vo06 gets no next_text. vo02+vo03 and vo08+vo09 may be one request each, sliced. 3 takes, fixed seeds, pick by ear. v3 only as one continuous request, sliced.
Never time-stretch more than ~4%; pick another take instead.
Keep quiet inhales before vo01, vo04, vo07, vo09 (-6 to -10 dB); one unbroken room-tone bed at about -48 to -45 dBFS through every silence (including the scan ticks and the 16.22 thunk, 15.75–16.75).
Phone-memo EQ: HPF ~90 Hz, -2 to -3 dB shelf from 10 kHz, 1-2 dB dip at 6-8 kHz + light de-ess; 2:1-3:1 compression, 2-4 dB GR; no reverb.
LIM is said as one word (lim) and is written 'lim' in the VO text so the voice never spells it. QSME = Q-S-me (kyoo-ess-mee). qsme.co.nz = Q-S-me dot co dot en zed.
If an ElevenLabs voice ships: TikTok AI-generated content label + Meta AI label.
